items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: she sent the trumpet to her sister, which is Nelisco, today her name is Nelisco Briscoe.

ctx.x: I was going to ask you about your education. Did you have any music in school at all?

No, no, no, no, no. It started, I had a niece, cousin rather, on the road years ago. I was around about fifteen. With a regular, a minister or a troop, whatever they call it, traveling around, you know. And she played trumpet. In other words, taking sick or what, she sent the trumpet to her sister, which is Nelisco, today her name is Nelisco Briscoe. And she began to learn on the trumpet. The sister did a twentieth century, it was called a twentieth century trumpet. It was a brass instrument, cornet. On it. And…
What was your cousin's name that had a trumpet on the road?
